QUOTE: When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ... ref={ref} />` (lines 128–136). The ref is forwarded as is
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the ref goes to NavigationSearch when hasSearch is true, but never says that the ref is attached to nothing when hasSearch is false. It says only that other callers pass a ref to their scroll view, which is a different claim.
